name: Make, edit and check a picture
description: A picture from a prompt with MOSS-Image (its prompt enhanced first), or a picture given to it; edited with FLUX 3 Klein (Q4_K_M, 8 steps) where an edit is asked for; then checked by a vision model. Answers the pictures' file references and the review's findings. Inputs: Prompt (what to make), Edit (a change, or empty), Picture (a picture to edit instead of making one: a data URL, at most about 2 MB, or empty).

data.label: Prompt
data.value: A ceramic coffee mug on a wooden desk by a window, morning light, with the words "GOOD MORNING" printed on the mug in red letters

data.label: What to make it from
data.code:
// what a picture is made from: the prompt, unless a picture was given to edit (then none is made)
return String(picture == null ? '' : picture).trim() ? '' : prompt;

data.label: Enhance the prompt (OpenMOSS's prompt enhancer)
data.systemPrompt: You turn a person's picture idea into one detailed English caption for MOSS-Image, a text-to-image model, as OpenMOSS's prompt enhancer does. Describe the visible picture concretely: the subject and what it is doing, its appearance, the setting, the framing, the medium, the lighting, materials, colour palette and mood. Keep every subject, count, relationship, style and exclusion the person asked for; add detail only where it makes the picture more specific, and keep a minimalist request minimalist. Quote any text that should appear in the picture exactly, in its own language, with its line breaks. Where the picture should be clean (a logo, an icon, a product shot), say plainly what must not appear: no other letters or words, no watermark. Write cohesive prose, one or two paragraphs, with no lists, JSON or quality tags. Reply with the caption alone.

data.label: The picture made, by reference
The picture to edit
The picture to review
data.code:
// the picture to review: the edited one where there is one, else the one made or given (by reference, as above)
return (edited && edited.file) || edited_image || source;

data.label: Before the edit
data.code:
// the picture before the edit, for the reviewer to compare (none without an edit)
return (edited || edited_image) ? source : null;

data.label: What to check
Review it (a vision model)
The result

oaiyTool.name: make_and_check_image
oaiyTool.description: Make a picture from a description (MOSS-Image, with the prompt enhanced first), optionally edit it (FLUX 3 Klein: say what to change in Edit, or leave Edit empty), and have a vision model check it for exact text, unintended text, colours, missing or extra objects, composition and whether the edit kept the rest. Leave Picture empty (it takes a picture as a data URL, to edit that instead). Returns the picture's file reference and the review's findings.
